name: FGR5 twins
status: exploratory demonstration for a figure; not a test
purpose: Show sensitive dependence and eventual capture directly: four FGR5 fresh starts (rows 8, 13, 35, 40, which FGR5 saw captured between 2176 and 4224 updates) are rerun as one batch together with copies nudged by relative 1e-12, 1e-10 and 1e-8 along one fixed random direction, and followed until period-3 capture, another recurrence candidate, or 16384 updates. The unnudged copies sit in another batch than in FGR5, so they need not reproduce the FGR5 trajectories after the first few hundred updates (FGR4b rounding control).
storage: All full-state updates in immutable 128-update shards outside Git, copied, fsynced and rehashed on /archive before advancing (the FGR3 Evidence class). Never splice failed attempts.
analysis: Relative distance of each nudged copy from its unnudged copy against update, and relative distance of every copy from the audited period-3 orbit; compared with the FGR3 finite-time growth rates and with log(spectral radius)/3 of the cycle. Descriptive only.
publication: Blog and report figure only after audit; no paid computation.
